message.zcinema.not_flat: That is not a flat wall of black concrete
gui.zcinema.hint: Stick + sneak + right-click to register a wall or open the panel; stick + right-click the core to remove it.
gui.zcinema.status.idle: Paste a direct or parsing link and press Load
gui.zcinema.status.no_range: (source has no Range support: rewinding re-decodes - use a Range-capable server)
gui.zcinema.status.error: Failed to open the stream (check the URL)
zcinema.configuration.sync.syncIntervalT: How often the server broadcasts the full playback state to viewers.
zcinema.configuration.sync.globalStallPa: When viewers report the source is unreachable, freeze the clock for everyone until playback recovers.
zcinema.configuration.stream.maxFrameWid: Frames wider than this are downscaled while decoding (saves bandwidth/CPU).
zcinema.configuration.stream.maxFrameHei: Frames taller than this are downscaled while decoding.
zcinema.configuration.stream.bufferSecon: How far ahead of the shared clock this client decodes.
zcinema.configuration.sync.hardResyncSec: If the shared clock and local playback diverge by more than this, the stream seeks instead of waiting.
zcinema.configuration.audio.audioDistanc: How far away the screen audio can be heard.
